name: X & Twitter Bookmarks Exporter
description: Export X, Twitter bookmarks to Markdown with date filtering

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://twitter.com https://x.com https://*.twimg.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none';
